extraction_issues.reason: Figure 3D/F and Supplementary Figure S1 were available as plot images/PDF context, but exact full dose-response curve points were not locally tabulated; only textual or table-supported values were promoted.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The local XML/text states LVTX-9-C18 causes about 10% hemolysis at 25 μM and stronger hemolysis above 25 μM, but does not tabulate the exact 50% at 50 μM value carried by DBAASP; Figure 3F is available only as a plotted image/caption in the local packet.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: DBAASP hemolysis row 22186 is preserved as source_conflict and is not promoted as a primary-source activity row; supported IC50 and approximate hemolysis/LDH values remain recorded.

parser_quality_control.normalization_policy: source μM/% units preserved; no μg/mL-to-μM conversion attempted
